cards.imageAlt: Figure 23，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Look at pictures, please say something about what you can see.
cards.audioTextZh: 请看图片并描述你在图中看到了什么。
cards.referenceText: From the picture on the left, I can see an engine on the ground. There are some plastic materials in the engine’s air intake, and it should be a foreign object damage (FOD). As for the right picture, the cowl of the engine is opened. Maybe it is under mechanical repairs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在左图中，我看到地面上有一个发动机，发动机的进气口有一些塑料材料，发动机受到异物损伤。右图中，发动机罩被打开，飞机可能正在接受机械修理。

cards.audioText: What damage did the engine have in the left picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 左图中的发动机受到了怎样的损害？
cards.referenceText: The plastic wrap will be ingested into the engine instantly through the turbine. The pieces of the plastic wrap will block the airway in the engine and will cause the engine overheat.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塑料膜会通过涡轮被立刻吸入发动机，塑料碎片会堵住发动机的通风孔，导致发动机过热。

cards.audioText: What's the danger if the aircraft engine ingested foreign objects?
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机吸入异物将会有什么危险？
cards.referenceText: During start-up, foreign objects may be ingested into the engines and damage the compressors, rotors and even other parts of the power plant. This may cause engine overheated, engine failure, engine fire or other damage, so foreign objects in the air intake are very dangerous to aircraft engines, and we should have a careful check of the air intake in the preflight preparation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在启动时，异物可能会被吸入发动机，损坏压缩机、发动机转子，甚至是动力装置的其它部分。这会导致发动机过热、发动机故障、发动机着火或其它损害。所以进气口的异物对发动机来说非常危险，在飞行前应对飞机进气口进行仔细的检查。

cards.audioText: If the engine ingested foreign objects during taxi, what would you do as a captain?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在滑行时发动机吸入异物，作为机长你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: In this case, I would shut down the damaged engine and report to ATC. I would ask for fire services if necessary. Then I would taxi to the apron with the power of another engine. At the same time, I should tell our company to cancel this flight or change to another aircraft to complete this flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这种情况下，我会将损坏的发动机关闭并将情况报告给ATC，如有必要我会请求消防设施。然后我会用另一个发动机的动力滑行回停机坪，同时我会通知公司取消航班或换另一架飞机来完成航班。

cards.audioText: Have you heard of any accident caused by foreign objects ingested into the engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾经听说过哪些发动机吸入异物导致的事故？
cards.referenceText: I heard that once a Boeing 737 encountered heavy hail when landing. The pilot failed to avoid the storm because of massive precipitation. Due to hail ingestion, both engines experienced a simultaneous complete power loss following a thrust roll-back. To make things worse, it also failed to use the auxiliary power unit (APU) to relight both engines. Whereafter the pilot shut down both engines and prepared for an emergency landing. Fortunately, they finally made a successful off-airport landing on a levee and there were no injuries.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我听说过曾经一架波音737-300在着陆时遭遇强冰雹，由于降水量大飞行员无法避开风暴。飞机的两个发动机因为吸入冰雹同时停止运作。更糟的是，飞机的发动机无法通过辅助动力装置再次启动。随后飞行员选择关掉发动机并准备紧急迫降。幸运的是，最后飞机成功地降落在码头并且无人受伤。

cards.audioText: What can you do to avoid foreign objects being ingested into the engine before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行前怎样做可以避免发动机吸入异物？
cards.referenceText: Besides making good preflight inspection, we should pay more attention to the outside conditions while taxiing. If we find any debris or foreign objects on the taxiways or runways, we must stop taxiing or reject takeoff, and report the situation to ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除了做好飞行前的检查，飞行员应该在飞机滑行时多关注飞机外面的情况。如果在滑行道或跑道上发现任何碎片或异物，则必须要停止滑行或中断起飞，然后将情况报告给ATC。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me the function of aircraft engine and the importance of engine check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说一说飞机发动机的功能和发动机检查的重要性吗？
cards.referenceText: Engine is a core component of the aircraft. It generates mechanical power to provide thrust allowing the plane to fly, so engine check in preflight inspection is very important. If there are foreign objects (ice, rubbish, waste plastics, damaged parts, etc.) in the air inlet, it may be ingested into the engines during engine start, and this may cause engine vibration, engine failure and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机是飞机的核心组件，发动机产生的动力为飞机飞行提供推力。所以飞行前对发动机的检查非常重要，如果有异物（冰、垃圾、塑料废弃物、损坏零件等）在发动机入口，那么异物可能在启动时被吸入发动机。这会导致发动机振动，发动机故障或其它问题。

cards.audioText: What procedures does your company have to deal with one engine failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司在处理单发失效时有什么流程？
cards.referenceText: First, contact ATC and state the problem. Then, for twin-engine plane, we must find the nearest airport to land or return to the departure airport. For single-engine plane, we must request for emergency landing, notify ATC, then cooperate with the rest crew members for passenger safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，联系ATC并报告问题。然后，对于双引擎飞机，必须找到最近的机场降落或是回到出发的机场。对于单引擎飞机，必须要请求紧急迫降，通知ATC，并和其他工作人员合作确保乘客的安全。
